summary: Sabesp filed a Form 6-K disclosing organizational changes to its Executive Board. Claudio Kawa Hermolin was appointed to lead the newly created Customer Experience Directorate, while Débora Pierini Longo stepped down as Director of Operations and Maintenance to head the Integrated Operations Center project, with Roberval Tavares temporarily accumulating Director roles. This is a routine management reshuffle aligned with strategic focus on customer experience and operational efficiency. No special-situation event such as a tender, acquisition, or restructuring is involved. What to watch: the shift signals increased emphasis on digital and customer-centric operations, but no arbitrage angle or material financial impact.
